webhooks.detail: Webhooks created in User Settings > API Access or via API (create/delete webhook endpoints); webhook payload docs and SDK verify helper exist; included on all plans.

evidence.quote: You also have the option of creating and deleting webhooks with an API call.

sandbox.detail: No separate sandbox. API keys and webhooks are included on all plans (incl. free), so a free account can test integrations; webhook 'Send test payload' button exists.

evidence.quote: Yes. API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.

rate_limits.summary: 60 calls / 60 s per account; heavy requests (summary/transcript) 30 / 60 s (may drop to 5); 429 + Retry-After

evidence.quote: Currently, you are able to make a maximum of 60 calls to the API in a 60 second window.
